content.title: Arkansas basketball beats Hawaii in March Madness: Final score
content.text: Updated March 19, 2026, 6:15 p.m. CTPORTLAND, Ore. — Arkansas basketball entered the 2025-26 season believing it could be a national title contender.The March Madness test of that will ultimately determine the accuracy of those expectations begins today.The No. 4 Razorbacks (26-8) face No. 13 Hawaii (24-8) in the first round of the NCAA Tournament. The two teams are in the West Region, and they are hoping to advance to a Round of 32 date against either No. 5 Wisconsin or No. 12 High Point.Arkansas enters the weekend on a high. The Hogs claimed the SEC Tournament title by winning three games in three days, outlast Vanderbilt in the final behind 30 points and 11 assists from Darius Acuff Jr.Hawaii defeated UC Irvine in the Big West Tournament finals and finished second in Big West play. The Rainbow Warriors are known for their defense, holding opponents to 69.7 points per game. The Razorbacks average 89.9.The Southwest Times Record is providing live updates throughout the Arkansas vs. Hawaii game. Follow along.Watch Arkansas vs Hawaii on Sling TVArkansas basketball vs Hawaii live score updatesSecond Half FINAL: Arkansas 97, Hawaii 78The Hogs led from start-to-finish and will now play High Point in the second round of the NCAA Tournament. Arkansas leads 91-71, 2:43The Razorbacks have gotten a little sloppy in recent minutes, but they still lead by 20 and are cruising to the finish line. Darius Acuff Jr. and Meleek Thomas have combined for 41 points and 12 assists in the first NCAA Tournament games of their careers. Arkansas leads 81-60, 7:54It's impressive that the Razorbacks aren't letting Hawaii get close in the period. Every punch from the 'Bows has a counter from the Razorbacks. Big men Trevon Brazile and Malique Ewin have combined for 23 points and 18 rebounds. Big-time performances with Nick Pringle sidelined. Arkansas leads 73-55, 11:26Darius Acuff Jr. is starting to cook. The freshman has scored the last seven points and is now up to 22 on the afternoon. Still no action for Meleek Thomas since he hobbled to the locker room early in the period. Arkansas leads 64-47, 14:59Hawaii calls a timeout as it looked like both teams needed a breather. The Razorbacks are maintaining their distance on the scoreboard. Meleek Thomas recently hobbled off the floor and down the tunnel, but he's back on the Arkansas bench during the current stoppage.First Half HALF: Arkansas 54, Hawaii 36Hunter Erickson banked a 3-pointer as the buzzer sounded, but he didn't get the shot off in time. The Hogs closed the period on an 8-0 run to lead by 18. This was a great start to the tournament for John Calipari's squad. Arkansas is shooting 61.1% and leading by double digits despite going 2 for 11 from the 3-point line. Meleek Thomas leads the way with 14 points, while Darius Acuff Jr. has 13, Malique Ewin has 10 and Trevon Brazile has nine. Arkansas leads 44-34, 3:28Hawaii is hanging around. The Rainbow Warriors have made five of their last seven 3-point attempts and are on the verge of getting this deficit down to single digits for the first time since the 16:11 mark of the first half. Arkansas leads 38-26, 5:29Some 3-pointers are starting to fall for the 'Bows. They've trimmed the deficit to 12 after falling behind by as many as 19. The freshmen are powering the Arkansas offense. Darius Acuff Jr. has 13 points and Meleek Thomas has 12. Both guards have three assists. Arkansas leads 24-7, 11:52The Razorbacks are playing some stingy defense with excellent ball-pressure from their backcourt. Hawaii is only scoring .438 points per possession. At the other end, Arkansas is shooting 64.3% with eight assists and a single turnover. Arkansas leads 11-0, 15:54Make it 11-0 after a mid-range jumper from Darius Acuff Jr. Hawaii is 0 for 7 overall and 0 for 4 on 3-pointers as we enter the first media timeout. Arkansas starts fast with 9-0 runHawaii has to call a timeout with 17:18 remaining in the first half and the Hogs leading by nine points. The Razorbacks are getting whatever they want on offense and have some easy layups from Meleek Thomas, Billy Richmond III and Darius Acuff Jr.Pregame Nick Pringle not in starting lineup, likely outDarius Acuff Jr, Meleek Thomas, Billy Richmond III, Trevon Brazile and Malique Ewin will be the first five for Arkansas basketball. Pringle did not participate during pregame warmups, instead stretching off to the side. When he did jog, it was gingerly. Arkansas looks like it is down to a six-man rotation and has one fewer big man against a talented Hawaii frontcourt. Nick Pringle remains questionableArkansas' starting center is listed as questionable on the final availability report that was just released. He did not go through workouts during the open practice on Wednesday and wore a sleeve on his right leg.What time does Arkansas vs Hawaii start?Date: Thursday, March 19Time: 3:25 p.m. CT Where: Moda Center in Portland, Ore.What TV channel is Arkansas vs Hawaii on today? TV Channel: TBSLivestream: NCAA March Madness Live app | Sling TVArkansas basketball vs Hawaii predictionArkansas' frontcourt will be tested, and it will be important for Trevon Brazile, Nick Pringle and Malique Ewin to avoid foul trouble. In the end, the Rainbow Warriors won't slow down the dynamic freshman duo of Acuff and Meleek Thomas. The Razorbacks will roll into the second round.
